help.text:
🤖 *Welcome*

Sends a welcome message (with or without a card) when someone joins the group.

🆕 "{{prefix}}welcome config" — turns it on with default options
📋 "{{prefix}}welcome status" — view and tweak the configuration
🧪 "{{prefix}}welcome test" — shows a preview without affecting anyone
🤖 "{{prefix}}welcome" — shows this help
help.needGroup: ⚠️ Run this command inside the group you want to configure.

watchGroup.label: Watched group
watchGroup.body:
Group I watch to welcome new members.
How to answer:
`message in the new group`
↳ starts watching that group
📌 For communities, use the announcements group.

useCard.label: Welcome card
useCard.body:
Image with the person's photo, sent along with the message.
How to answer:
`sim`
↳ with card
`não`
↳ message only, no card

cardTarget.label: Target group
cardTarget.body:
Group where the welcome is sent.
How to answer:
`message in the group`
↳ sends the welcome there
`padrão`
↳ uses the watched group

groupName.label: Group name
groupName.body:
Name shown in the welcome and on the card.
How to answer:
`a name`
↳ uses that name
`padrão`
↳ uses the group's own name

cardMessage.label: Welcome message
cardMessage.body:
Text sent when someone joins.
How to answer:
`a text`
↳ uses your text
`padrão`
↳ uses the default message
📌 Variables: {nome}, {grupo}
📌 Default:
{{defaultMessage}}

smallWelcomeMessage.label: Plain-text welcome message
smallWelcomeMessage.body:
Text sent in the extra groups (no card).
How to answer:
`a text`
↳ uses your text
`padrão`
↳ reuses the main message
📌 Variables: {nome}, {grupo}

dmMessage.label: DM message (optional)
dmMessage.body:
Message sent in the DM of whoever joins.
How to answer:
`a text`
↳ uses your text
`padrão`
↳ uses the suggested message
`nenhuma`
↳ sends nothing in DM
📌 Variables: {nome}
📌 Suggestion:
{{defaultMessage}}

cardBackground.label: Card background
cardBackground.body:
Card background.
How to answer:
`theme`
↳ ready-made theme
`#hex`
↳ color with automatic gradient
`sólido #hex`
↳ solid color
`gradiente #hex1 #hex2`
↳ 2-color gradient
`image`
↳ send a photo as background
`escurecer 0-100`
↳ darkens an image background (%)
`padrão`
↳ purple theme
📌 Themes: {{themes}}
📌 Example: #1f1147

cardFrame.label: Avatar frame
cardFrame.body:
Frame around the profile photo on the card.
How to answer:
`frame`
↳ uses the chosen frame
`padrão`
↳ circle
📌 Frames: {{frames}}

cardFont.label: Card font
cardFont.body:
Font of the card text.
How to answer:
`font`
↳ uses the chosen font
`padrão`
↳ default font
📌 Fonts: {{fonts}}

cardAvatar.label: Default card photo
cardAvatar.body:
Card photo for people without a profile picture.
How to answer:
`image`
↳ send the photo to use
`padrão`
↳ back to the plugin's default photo

smallWelcomeGroups.label: Plain-text groups
smallWelcomeGroups.body:
Extra groups that get the plain-text welcome.
How to answer:
`message in the group`
↳ adds the group (again, removes it)
`pronto`
↳ finish
`nenhuma`
↳ turns them all off

wizard.timeout: ⏱️ Setup ended due to inactivity (10 minutes with no reply).
wizard.smallWelcomeAdded:
✅ Added: "{{name}}".
Send another group or type "pronto".
wizard.smallWelcomeRemoved:
➖ Removed: "{{name}}".
Send another group, or type "pronto".
wizard.savedCard:
🎉 *Welcome is on, with card!* It already applies to the next person who joins.

Type "{{prefix}}welcome status" to see or tweak anything.
wizard.savedSimple:
🎉 *Welcome is on, message only!* It already applies to the next person who joins.

Want the card later? Type "{{prefix}}welcome set card" and answer "sim".
To see or tweak the rest: "{{prefix}}welcome status".
wizard.alreadyInProgress:
⚠️ You already have a setup or edit in progress.

Type "cancelar" in that chat, or wait for it to expire.
wizard.startConfigNeedGroup: ⚠️ Run this command inside the group that will start the configuration.
wizard.confirmConfig:
👋 Are you sure you want to set up welcome messages for new members in this group?

Type *sim* (yes) or *não* (no).
wizard.chooseCard:
🖼️ Welcome with a card?
The card is an image with the person's photo.
How to answer:
`sim`
↳ with card
`não`
↳ message only (any other answer too)
📌 Change it later: {{prefix}}welcome set card
wizard.alreadyConfigured:
This group already has welcome messages configured.

Type "{{prefix}}welcome status" to see it, or "{{prefix}}welcome reset" to delete it and start over.

status.needGroup: ⚠️ Run this command inside the group you want to check.
status.notConfigured:
This group doesn't have welcome messages configured yet.

Run "{{prefix}}welcome config" to turn it on.
status.fieldsList:
*Fields you can adjust* (`{{prefix}}welcome set FIELD value`):

{{fields}}

fieldDesc.mensagem: welcome text (goes with the card, if on)
fieldDesc.card: turns the card with the person's photo on/off (sim/não)
fieldDesc.destino: group where the welcome is sent
fieldDesc.nomegrupo: name shown in the welcome messages
fieldDesc.pv: message sent to the person's DM
fieldDesc.fundo: card background: color, gradient or image
fieldDesc.moldura: photo frame on the card: circulo, neon, quadrado
fieldDesc.avatar: photo used on the card for people without a profile picture
fieldDesc.simples: welcome text in the extra groups (text only)
fieldDesc.simplesgrupo: extra groups that get the plain-text welcome (advanced)

reset.needGroup: ⚠️ Run this command inside the group you want to reset.
reset.nothing: This group has no configuration to delete.
reset.confirmNeeded:
⚠️ *Heads up*
This deletes this group's entire welcome configuration.

Are you sure? Type "{{prefix}}welcome reset confirmar" to delete it for good.
reset.done:
✅ Configuration deleted.

Run "{{prefix}}welcome config" whenever you want to set it up again.

set.needGroup: ⚠️ Run this command inside the configured group.
set.notConfigured:
This group doesn't have a configuration yet.

Run "{{prefix}}welcome config" first.
set.invalidField:
⚠️ Invalid field.

Use one of these: {{fields}}.
Ex: "{{prefix}}welcome set moldura neon"
set.suggestSimplesGrupo: 💡 You edited the plain-text message, but there's no group set in "simplesgrupo" to receive it yet. Type "{{prefix}}welcome set simplesgrupo" to choose the groups.
set.cardOffNote: 💡 The card is off, so this won't show up yet. To turn it on: "{{prefix}}welcome set card" and answer "sim".

applySet.imageDownloadFail: ⚠️ Couldn't download that image, try again.
applySet.darkenOnlyImage:
⚠️ This only applies to an image background.

Send an image first with the caption "{{prefix}}welcome set fundo".
applySet.backgroundInvalid:
⚠️ Didn't get that background.

Use a theme ({{themes}}), a #hex code, "sólido #hex", "gradiente #hex1 #hex2", or send the image with the caption "{{prefix}}welcome set fundo".
applySet.frameInvalid:
⚠️ Invalid frame.

Use one of these: {{frames}}.
applySet.fontInvalid:
⚠️ Invalid font.

Use one of these: {{fonts}}.
applySet.avatarNeedsImage: ⚠️ Send an image along with "{{prefix}}welcome set avatar" to use as the default photo, or type "{{prefix}}welcome set avatar padrão" to go back to the plugin's default photo.
applySet.cardInvalid:
⚠️ Didn't get that. Type "sim" to use the card with the photo, or "não" for a plain message.

To change the welcome *text*, use "{{prefix}}welcome set mensagem".
applySet.groupNeedsGroup: ⚠️ This field doesn't take typed text — to change the watched group, just type "{{prefix}}welcome set grupo" (no value) and then send a message inside the new group.
applySet.groupSame: ⚠️ That's already the current watched group — nothing to change.
applySet.groupTaken: ⚠️ {{target}} already has its own configuration — pick a different group, or run "{{prefix}}welcome reset" there first.
applySet.targetNeedsGroup: ⚠️ This field doesn't take typed text — to change the target group, just type "{{prefix}}welcome set destino" (no value) and then send a message inside the new group, or "{{prefix}}welcome set destino padrão" to use the watched group.
applySet.simplesGroupNeedsGroup: ⚠️ This field doesn't take typed text — just type "{{prefix}}welcome set simplesgrupo" (no value) and I'll guide you, or "{{prefix}}welcome set simplesgrupo nenhuma" to turn it all off.

test.notConfigured:
⚠️ This chat has no configuration associated with it.

Run "{{prefix}}welcome config" inside the configured group, or check with "{{prefix}}welcome status".
test.previewHeader:
🧪 *Welcome preview*

This is just a simulation using your own contact data — nothing was sent to the real groups.
test.previewCardLabel: 🧪 Card that would be sent to "{{target}}":
test.previewMessageLabel: 🧪 Message that would be sent to "{{target}}":
test.previewSmallLabel: 🧪 Plain-text welcome that would be sent to "{{target}}":
test.previewDmLabel: 🧪 Message that would be sent in the DM:
test.previewNoDm: 🧪 DM message disabled — nothing would be sent.
test.previewFooter: ✅ Preview complete. Nothing was sent to the configured groups.
test.realHeader: 🧪 *Real test* — sending to the actual configured groups, using your own data. Every message is marked as a test.
test.realDone: ✅ Real test complete. Check the configured groups.

• No spam links, flooding, or annoying content
• Keep topics on-topic

Hope you enjoy the group!
